basic_profile.bio: TechieTrekker is a seasoned tech enthusiast from Portland, Oregon, who has been building and troubleshooting computers since their early teens. With a degree in Computer Science and a career in IT support, they spend their evenings and weekends helping others solve tech-related issues on various forums. An avid bird watcher, they often spend weekends hiking and capturing wildlife photography. In a committed relationship, they also enjoy indie podcasts and exploring open-source software. Typically active on Reddit during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a strong foundation in IT support and a degree in Computer Science, TechieTrekker has honed their expertise through both formal education and hands-on experience in troubleshooting hardware and software issues. They are particularly skilled in network configurations and custom PC builds.
